run_sacred_experiment: run the sacred hello_config experiment that prints a configurable greeting message
create_named_config: create a named config in sacred to override default config values like recipient and message
create_default_config: create a default config in sacred that sets recipient and message variables for the experiment
run_experiment_with_rude_config: run the sacred experiment with the rude named config to print a rude greeting
review_automain_entry: review the sacred automain decorated main function that prints the experiment name and message
